question: Does query-time adaptive deepening or eager Python facet materialization improve the compiled possibility preprocessor on a relational/hyperbinding synthetic workload?
coherence_observation: Compiling an anchor while the graph fixture was still mutating broke exact equivalence; rebuilding only after the graph epoch was complete restored equivalence. A compiled possibility field must therefore derive from an immutable/coherent graph epoch or be invalidated and recompiled.

fusion.architecture_delta: NO_NEW_RUNTIME_CODE_REQUIRED: current possibility_preprocessor_v10 already represents DENSE_BITSET_LE as a Python integer and intersects bitsets without expanding full member sets. Preserve that shape.
fusion.default_policy: Do not deepen traversal merely because more hops are available. Deepen only when unresolved pressure or a query-class discriminator predicts information gain sufficient to pay the latency/instability cost.
fusion.facet_policy: Keep dynamic facets after structural possibility compilation and apply them with compact ordinal encodings/direct bit operations; avoid full Python set reconstruction on the hot path.
fusion.epoch_policy: Graph/source/field generations must be coherent and immutable for the lifetime of a compiled field read; mixed-generation access fails closed.

strongest_counterhypothesis: A held-out workload with decisive evidence beyond depth 2, sparse lexical anchors, or different graph branching may benefit from adaptive deepening; this negative result is workload-specific and must not disable configurable deeper compilation globally.
limitations: Synthetic model-authored fixture; not real Clay corpus.
Local ChatGPT Python environment; not Hostinger or Andreas Ubuntu target.
The candidate scoring/ground truth are partially algorithm-coupled, so accuracy values are not independent superiority evidence.
No concurrent writer/load benchmark in this experiment.
next_falsifier: Run a held-out real-corpus/OOD slice stratified by required graph distance and compare fixed depth, intent-gated deepening and recursive SQL while measuring counterevidence recall, p50/p95/p99, build/update amortization and stale-generation rejection.
